adminCreate.title: Add account
adminCreate.usernameHelper: Defaults to the part of the email before @ and cannot be changed after creation.
adminCreate.managerTip: Choosing a "Manage" store automatically grants the Store Manager role.
adminCreate.managerAuto: {{count}} "Manage" store(s) selected: the Store Manager role is granted automatically.
adminCreate.passwordEmailUnsupported: For now the initial password can only be set directly. Sending a password setup email needs backend support first; the option will appear here once available.
adminCreate.passwordHelper: 6–100 characters. Share it in person or through a secure channel.

passwordErrors.tooShort: The password needs at least 6 characters
passwordErrors.tooLong: The password can be at most 100 characters
passwordErrors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match

adminCreate.rolesSheetHint: The Store Manager role comes from "Manage" stores, so it is not listed here.
adminCreate.optionsLoadFailed: Could not load the options. Please try again later.
adminCreate.uncertain: The result of the create request was not confirmed (network timeout or server error). The account may already exist. Tap "Check result" first and do not submit again.
adminCreate.storesFailed: The account was created (step 1 done) but the "Manage" store settings were not saved (step 2 failed). Profile and roles are saved. Tap "Retry saving stores" — it will not create the account again — or set it later in access.
adminCreate.verifyFound: An account with this name exists. Open its details to check; no need to create it again if it is correct.
adminCreate.verifyNotConfirmed: This account was not found and the result is still unconfirmed. Check again later or contact an administrator.
adminCreate.verifyFailed: Could not check. Please try again later.
adminCreate.passwordNotice: You set the initial password and no email is sent. Share it in person or through a secure channel.
adminCreate.storesPendingNotice: The account was created but the "Manage" store scope is not saved yet. Check and set it in access, otherwise the Store Manager role is not granted.
adminCreate.stepLogin: Sign in to the App with the account and the initial password you set
adminCreate.stepChangePassword: Change it to a personal password soon after signing in
